title: This Bird Can Copy a Chainsaw and a Camera Shutter

scenes.text: This bird can copy a chainsaw. And a camera.
It's the superb lyrebird of Australia.
It copies other birds, a car alarm, and a camera shutter with a motor drive.
One captive lyrebird at Adelaide Zoo learned power-tool sounds while builders worked nearby.
A real kookaburra once answered its fake call.
The male does it to impress a mate.
A bird that learned to sound like a machine.
